fieldNotes.truckGate: Street View (Oct 2022) shows a chain-link gate with green privacy slats labeled 'GATE 1' on a swing/sliding gate on the SW side of the property; trailers staged immediately inside the fence.
fieldNotes.guardShack: No staffed guard booth visible at GATE 1 — it is an unattended labeled swing gate; access appears to be remote/badge-based, so remoteGs is true.
fieldNotes.remoteGs: Labeled 'GATE 1' swing gate with no booth = remote check-in / badge access.
fieldNotes.truckGateCount: Gate signage reads 'GATE 1', implying at least one more numbered gate on the perimeter.
fieldNotes.backupSensitive: Tight urban-edge site: the SW truck gate opens directly onto a narrow plant road with little stacking room; a queue would back onto the road.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: Dock banks along the large NW warehouse and process buildings; ~28 estimated, partly obscured by roof structures - flagged uncertain.
fieldNotes.dropArea: Multiple trailer-parking rows inside the SW fence and along the warehouse; 25-50 band.
fieldNotes.shipRcvSeparate: Distinct dock clusters on the warehouse and on separate process-side buildings.
fieldNotes.railServed: Active rail line runs along the west edge and into the mill; rail car at a mill dock visible in Street View.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Site sits inside the City of Plattsburgh, surrounded by residential streets and commercial development - clearly Urban.
fieldNotes.multipleFacilities: Multi-building campus: process mill, large converting/warehouse, office building, plus ancillary structures.
